answer: Sampling runs on a comet schedule: 2 percent of submissions per epoch, drawn without replacement. A selected claim is re-graded by 3 agents, and disagreement dilutes the payout to 1 of 3 shares. Every submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replayed sonnet is caught on the second read. Last month an anchor of copied text cost 14 of 900 sampled accounts their whole epoch.
